dns.cloudflare_not_connected: Cloudflare not connected — connect an API token in Security → Cloudflare.
dns.cf_zone_not_found: Domain not found on your Cloudflare account — add it to CF first.
ftp.title: FTP users
backup.restore_warning: Restore overwrites existing data. Checksums are verified before restoring.
mail.not_installed: Mail stack (Postfix + Dovecot + Rspamd) is not installed yet.
mail.dkim_auto: DKIM key is generated automatically (selector forge).
mail.confirm_delete_domain: Deleting a mail domain deletes ALL its mailboxes and messages. Continue?
deliver.validator_hint: Check whether your authentication records are set up correctly — and get concrete fix instructions.
deliver.spf_missing: Add an SPF TXT record, e.g. v=spf1 a mx ~all
deliver.dkim_missing: DKIM record not found — create the mail domain in the panel (DKIM is generated automatically) and add the forge._domainkey TXT to DNS.
deliver.dmarc_missing: Add a _dmarc TXT record, e.g. v=DMARC1; p=quarantine; rua=mailto:dmarc@your-domain
deliver.dmarc_none: Policy p=none only monitors, it does not protect — raise to quarantine or reject once alignment is confirmed.
deliver.rbl_hint: The server IP is checked daily against 30+ lists; a new listing alerts the admin.
deliver.rbl_admin_only: RBL monitor and mail queue are visible to admins only.
deliver.dmarc_hint: Aggregate (rua) reports delivered to the panel mailbox are parsed and shown: who sends on behalf of your domains.
deliver.dmarc_empty: No parsed DMARC reports. Add rua=mailto:dmarc@domain to the _dmarc record and create a dmarc@ mailbox.
deliver.queue_hint: Postfix queue with the deferral reason per message.
deliver.confirm_delete_all: Delete ALL messages from the queue?
alarm.title: Alarm channels and thresholds
alarm.test_none: No channel configured or alarms disabled
dash.status_hint: Public page with your domains' availability and SSL expiry — share the link with clients.
waf.title: ModSecurity WAF
waf.hint: OWASP CRS per domain. Blocked requests and one-click whitelist (false positives).
waf.no_blocks: No blocked requests in the log.
migrator.title: Migrate from other panels
migrator.intro: Import from cPanel (cpmove) or Plesk (backup XML). Analysis is a dry-run — it shows what will be created before you confirm.
migrator.import_hint: Creates vhosts and databases; transfer files and mail separately.
migrator.confirm_import: Start import? Vhosts and databases will be created for the selected subscription.
git.title: Git deploy
updates.run_scan: Run a scan to list components.
docker.name: Name
security.confirm_restore: Restoring a quarantined file to its original location. Are you sure it is clean?
dist.auto: Auto-apply updates (in background, as soon as master publishes)
lic.node_intro: Enter the license key you got from the master. The panel activates and re-validates periodically (catches suspend/expiry).
lic.tiers_hint: Categories the master assigns to licenses (e.g. standard/pro/enterprise). Edit them freely.
lic.need_key: Generate a signing key (Distribution) to be able to issue licenses.
lic.license_not_found: License key not found on the master.
lic.token_invalid: Token signature invalid — check the master public key.
lic.banner_suspended: This panel's license is suspended — resource creation is blocked.
lic.banner_expired: This panel's license has expired — resource creation is blocked.
lic.banner_revoked: This panel's license was revoked — resource creation is blocked.
lic.banner_inactive: This panel's license is not active.
dist.master_intro: This panel as the source: publish a signed release that all connected panels pull and verify before applying.
dist.pubkey_hint: Paste it into each node panel (Distribution → Node) so it can verify your signatures.
dist.node_intro: Connect this panel to a master: enter the master address and its public key. Updates apply only after signature verification.
dist.not_configured: Master not configured — enter address and public key.
dist.apply_confirm: Apply the signed update? A backup is taken, but test on a staging panel first.
system.title: System settings
system.intro: Global panel settings. Values apply to new operations (AutoSSL, new domains, DNS).
system.acme_email_hint: Let's Encrypt contact for issuing/renewing certificates.
system.panel_fqdn_hint: Address the panel listens on (e.g. panel.yourdomain.com).
about.tagline: The ultimate web hosting control panel for Ubuntu Server 26.04 LTS — everything included, no compromises.
about.rights_body: All source code, design, database and related logic are the property of the author. Copying, redistribution, resale, unauthorized modification on the production server, reverse engineering, and removal or alteration of copyright notices are strictly prohibited.
bulk.title: Bulk
config.intro: Every change to a config the panel writes (nginx/FPM/Apache/Postfix...) is versioned.
config.confirm_restore: Restoring the entire config history to this point. Current state is snapshotted first. Continue?
users.site_access_hint: Selected websites are assigned to this user (Plesk-style). The user sees and manages only those.
users.reseller_pkg_hint: Total resources the reseller may allocate to their clients.
users.reseller_quota_exceeded: Reseller package has no free resources for this plan.
users.last_admin: This is the last active admin — it cannot be suspended or deleted (it would lock you out).
plan.reseller_pkg_hint: Plan meant to be assigned to resellers — defines how much they can resell in total.
reseller.quota_hint: Your package (limit) versus what you've already allocated to clients.
brand.name: Panel name
brand.host_hint: Own domain with own SSL; clients never see the ForgePanel brand.
staging.title: Staging
deliv.title: E-mail deliverability
apps.title: Applications
apps.ghost_started: Ghost is installing — when the task finishes, complete admin setup at /ghost/.
files.open_hint: Files open in full view for clarity.
assistant.intro: Optional module. Enter your own Anthropic API key — the assistant reads server context and suggests, but never changes anything itself.
assistant.not_configured: AI assistant not configured — enter your Anthropic API key in Forge AI.
assistant.placeholder: e.g. Why did nginx return 502? Explain this fail2ban jail…
assistant.context_hint: Paste config or log the assistant should see
assistant.disclaimer: The assistant only reads and suggests. You confirm and apply every change yourself through the panel.
term.title: Sandboxed terminal
term.sandbox_note: Isolated container — only the vhost directory mounted, no network, as the vhost user.
profile.title: Profile & security
profile.totp_hint: Second factor via an app (Aegis, Google Authenticator, 1Password…).
profile.totp_scan: Enter the secret into your app, then confirm with a generated code:
profile.webauthn_hint: Hardware key (YubiKey…) or platform authenticator (fingerprint, Windows Hello) as a second factor.
profile.webauthn_unsupported: This browser does not support WebAuthn.
db.pw_keep_hint: Leave empty to keep current password.
db.pma_install_hint: phpMyAdmin is not installed on the server.
db.pma_pma_not_installed: phpMyAdmin is not installed on the server.
db.pma_no_db_user_with_stored_password: This database has no panel-created DB user — add a user and try again.
mail.webmail_installing: Webmail (Roundcube) installation started — watch the task.
mail.webmail_hostname: Webmail hostname (DNS A record must point to this server):
ssl.renew_started: AutoSSL renewal started — watch the task.
ssl.key_hint: Unencrypted key. Verified to match the certificate; the cert must cover the domain.
ssl.chain_hint: Issuer intermediate certificates — usually a separate .ca-bundle file
ai.welcome: Hi! Ask me anything about the server — I diagnose from metrics, logs and configuration. I only read and suggest; you always confirm changes.
files.no_vhosts: No websites yet — create a domain first.
cf.title: Cloudflare integration
cf.intro: Connect a scoped Cloudflare API token for DNS sync, proxy and cache purge.
cf.token_hint: Token with Zone:DNS:Edit and Zone:Cache Purge permissions
